entries.title: Primary Change History
entries.durableReversalProof: REVERSALPROOF-01: verified-<digest>.json records bind repository, PR, commit patch/trailers, authorizing review/finding and verified region units; retained across history-cache expiry and review/head changes; reuse rechecks provenance, parent-state region equivalence, finding coverage and effective strict policy
entries.reversalSnapshotProof: SAFETYSTOPOWNER-01: subsequent authoritative snapshots may pin the original cited reversal when the first snapshot predates it; original-parent review currency, immutable identity, exact changed content and cited-region coverage remain required
entries.diagnosticCollection: snapshot attribution is operator opt-in only, 20 commits and 15 seconds; shared reads retain commit-file attribution from rename proof reads, capped at 20 commits when no destination exists
entries.transientMigrationProof: MIGRENUMBERDERIVED-01: migrationRenumberProofs are hash-verified after history reuse, never cached; body-verified candidates sharing a registry normalize together with unique pair markers and exactly one tuple each; MIGRENUMBERDERIVED-02 also verifies Alembic wrappers, paired revision modules and explicit module registries at every observed hammer snapshot against the protected author head; evaluator returns head/base/blob-bound mechanical-migration-renumber derivedChanges with an observed chain; MIGRENUMBERDERIVED-03 author-SQL proofs bind moduleOrigin, sqlPath/sqlDestination, primarySqlBlob/sqlBlob, moduleIdentity and snapshotMergeBase; rebased non-monotonic chains require head-bound transient migrationRenumberAncestry status=diverged and no slot below the author slot; diagnostics remain outside missingEvidence, its summary and stop identity; no candidates skips diagnostics and timer/load sampling
entries.laneReversalProof: LANEREVERSAL-01: transient laneOwner and laneIdentity bind final-fix-all PR/source-head custody and job trailer to exact-commit verified produced launch/class identity; shared review/finding/region proofs apply; lane history bypasses disk reuse and does not populate durable HAM reversal observations.
